quests.instruction: What two letters do you hear at the start of "SHELL"?
quests.question: /sh/ as in SHELL
quests.hint: These two letters team up to make ONE brand-new sound: /sh/.
quests.explanation: Together, SH makes just one sound: /sh/. That is the digraph in "SHELL"!
quests.funFact: Did you know? words like 'Ship' and 'Shoe' start with this quiet digraph.

quests.instruction: What two letters do you hear at the end of "LOCK"?
quests.question: /k/ as in LOCK
quests.hint: Do not say each letter alone -- together they make just one sound, /k/.
quests.explanation: Together, CK makes just one sound: /k/. That is the digraph in "LOCK"!
quests.funFact: Here's a cool fact: it makes exactly the same sound as a regular K.
